features.name: log_scaled_heavy_tail_composite
features.description: Log1p-transformed sum of heavy-tailed high-variance columns to smooth outliers for linear margins.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses extreme tails into a near-linear severity score useful for SVM hyperplane separation.
features.formula: np.log1p(np.abs(V12)) + np.log1p(np.abs(V13)) + np.log1p(np.abs(V15)) + np.log1p(np.abs(V17)) + np.log1p(np.abs(V28)) + np.log1p(np.abs(V29))

features.name: normalized_v12_z
features.description: Approximate z-score for V12 using training mean and std for stable linear projection.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides normalized scale for the highly skewed V12 column, beneficial for linear margins.

features.name: log1p_v9_v17_v28_product
features.description: Log-sum interaction between three skewed columns reflecting compound complexity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures multiplicative coupling of difficulty signals in a linear-friendly additive log form.

features.name: v14_v32_redundancy_deviation
features.description: Absolute deviation between V14 and V32 which share identical training statistics; measures discrepancy.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights cases where two near-duplicate columns diverge, providing a sparse linear signal.

features.name: low_variance_v33_v43_severity
features.description: Combined magnitude of low-variance columns V33 and V43 which spike rarely.
features.expected_model_benefit: Surface rare spikes in tight-distribution columns as a smooth severity signal.

features.name: negative_mass_score
features.description: Sum over columns that frequently take negative values, measuring negative directional pressure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a one-sided linear projection capturing the negative half-space of bounded columns.
features.formula: np.clip(-V1, 0, 5) + np.clip(-V2, 0, 5) + np.clip(-V14, 0, 5) + np.clip(-V32, 0, 5) + np.clip(-V45, 0, 5) + np.clip(-V51, 0, 5)

features.name: positive_mass_score
features.description: Sum over heavy positive-tail columns capturing upward pressure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth bounded composite of positive excursions ideal for linear SVM weight assignment.
features.formula: np.clip(V8, 0, 10) + np.clip(V9, 0, 10) + np.clip(V11, 0, 10) + np.clip(V20, 0, 15) + np.clip(V22, 0, 15) + np.clip(V36, 0, 20)

features.name: ratio_v13_v15
features.description: Ratio of two related skewed magnitude columns with safe denominator.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures relative scaling between two skewed proof-related measurements.

features.name: global_l2_magnitude_smoothed
features.description: Square root of sum of squares of a representative subset, log-smoothed for linear margins.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth overall row-norm signal that linearly correlates with row activity intensity.

features.name: extreme_outlier_count
features.description: Count of columns where the value exceeds roughly 3 standard deviations from training mean.
features.expected_model_benefit: Coarse but linear-friendly count of extreme deviations across heavy-tail features.
features.formula: np.where(np.abs(V12) > 3.5, 1, 0) + np.where(np.abs(V13) > 2.5, 1, 0) + np.where(np.abs(V15) > 2.5, 1, 0) + np.where(np.abs(V17) > 2.8, 1, 0) + np.where(np.abs(V20) > 3.3, 1, 0) + np.where(np.abs(V28) > 3.2, 1, 0) + np.where(np.abs(V29) > 3.0, 1, 0) + np.where(np.abs(V36) > 3.4, 1, 0)

features.name: row_complexity_judgment
features.description: Semantic assessment of overall row complexity combining magnitude, spread, and outlier presence into a 0-1 smoothness-friendly score, interpreted as a difficulty proxy.
features.expected_model_benefit: Bounded smooth scalar summarizing row difficulty, well-suited for linear SVM contribution.

features.name: row_sparsity_judgment
features.description: Semantic estimate of how concentrated the row's signal is in a few features versus spread across many, expressed as a 0-1 sparsity index.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides an orthogonal structural signal to magnitude features, helpful for linear separation across heuristic regimes.
